cd /work/ProbabilityTheoryFormalization && perl -0pi -e 's/simpa only \[cdf_eq μ\] using ProbabilityTheory\.tendsto_cdf_atBot \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/change Tendsto (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) x) atBot (𝓝 0)
  exact ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atBot (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/simpa only \[cdf_eq μ\] using ProbabilityTheory\.tendsto_cdf_atTop \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/change Tendsto (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) x) atTop (𝓝 1)
  exact ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atTop (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/simpa only \[cdf_eq μ\] using ProbabilityTheory\.monotone_cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/change Monotone (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) x)
  exact ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/simpa only \[cdf_eq μ\] using
    \(ProbabilityTheory\.cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\)\)\.right_continuous x/change ContinuousWithinAt (fun y => ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ) y) (Ici x) x
  exact (ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ)).right_continuous x/; s/have he : ∀ᶠ x in atBot, measureCdf μ x < u :=
    \(tendsto_order\.1 \(tendsto_atBot μ\)\)\.2 0 hu/have he : ∀ᶠ x in atBot, measureCdf μ x < u :=
    (tendsto_atBot μ).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hu)/; s/have he : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, u < measureCdf μ x :=
    \(tendsto_order\.1 \(tendsto_atTop μ\)\)\.1 1 hu/have he : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, u < measureCdf μ x :=
    (tendsto_atTop μ).eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hu)/; s/intro x hx
  by_contra hxa/intro x hx
  change measureCdf μ x < u at hx
  by_contra hxa/; s/filter_upwards \[\] with y hy/filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy/; s/have hyS : y ∈ S := lt_of_not_ge hnot/have hyS : y ∈ S := by
      change measureCdf μ y < u
      exact lt_of_not_ge hnot/; s/intro y hyS
    by_contra hyx/intro y hyS
    change measureCdf μ y < u at hyS
    by_contra hyx/; s/  apply le_csSup \(lowerSet_bddAbove μ hv\.2\)
  have hq_mem[\s\S]*?  exact hq_mem/  exact csSup_mono (lowerSet_bddAbove μ hv.2) (lowerSet_nonempty μ hu.1)
    (fun y hy => lt_trans hy huv_strict)/' ProbabilityTheory/chapter_10/thm_10_8_support.lean
PATH=/opt/lean/bin:$PATH lake env lean ProbabilityTheory/chapter_10/thm_10_8_support.lean
